limitations.quote: I’ll make the light and countdown change together on the edge after the count reaches 1.
limitations.note: The rewrite stopped the repeated green reload, but it also removed the buffered light timing, eliminated the count-0 sample at phase changes, and asserted red during reset instead of preserving the original all-off outputs.

The test expected the rewritten timing, including a direct transition from green at count 1 to yellow at count 5, so it passed without detecting the missing count-0 sample or the changed reset outputs.

limitations.quote: Trace the current state, light buffer, visible outputs, and timer across the boundary before editing any pipeline stage.
limitations.note: The agent read this directly relevant advice, but it did not change the approach: the agent treated the buffered timing as a defect and rewrote it rather than preserving it.
